headline: Iraq's National Security Service Uncovers Oil Smuggling Operations
summary: Iraq's National Security Service discovered a tapped oil pipeline and seized a modified tanker as part of an ongoing campaign against oil theft and smuggling.
why: Illegal oil bunkering and smuggling operations impact national hydrocarbon revenue accounting and domestic energy security in key producing nations.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Crackdowns on oil smuggling help protect state hydrocarbon revenues.
